body:
This PR updates the lifecycle `getWidgetSearchParameters` in `connectPagination` to add the default value without `uiState`. We don't apply the previous value on purpose, the `uiState` drives completely the `SearchParameters`.

I've not removed the `getConfiguration` lifecycle (yet) to avoid breaking everything. Once we've made the switch to `getWidgetSearchParameters` we'll remove them.
title: feat(connectPagination): update getWidgetSearchParameters
